manifesto.titleLead: Technology should not make people travel one more time.
manifesto.titleDim: It should clear the way for you.
manifesto.sub: The hard part of cross-border life is rarely “not knowing” — it is “knowing, and still having to make many trips.” Lugang Connect puts policy, paperwork and travel into one conversation: we find out first, then stay with you to the end.

stats.desc: Hong Kong livelihood, education, finance and transport, plus Shandong policy
Continuously collected, cleaned and updated from government websites

items.title: Understand policy
items.text: Based on your status, city and stage of life, we translate official documents into actionable Chinese answers and keep every source.

items.title: Get things done
items.text: We do more than tell you where to go: we open the page, line up the documents, fill in the forms, and ask you to confirm each item before submission.

items.title: Connect both places
items.text: From Jinan to Hong Kong and from Victoria Harbour back to Qilu: transport, education, banking and starting a business, connected in one conversation.

policy.head: HONG KONG · IMMIGRATION
policy.docTitle: Top Talent Pass Scheme renewal arrangements

cities.sub: We turn the most common choices between the two places into step-by-step routes — not a pile of information, but a line you can actually walk to the end.

cards.title: Go to Hong Kong
cards.text: Study, work, open an account, start a business. From visas and identity to schools and banks, then your first lease — every step of landing in Hong Kong, made clear.

cards.title: Return to Shandong
cards.text: Invest, settle, find policies, connect with industrial parks. Shandong's industry opportunities, talent subsidies and support policies, organised into a checklist you can act on.

tech.p: The model understands you; government websites answer you. Lugang Connect keeps a clear chain of evidence between the two: every conclusion can return to the source, and every update carries a timestamp.
tech.bubbleTail: first, then I'll give you steps you can follow.

proof.quote: “I want Shandong people in Hong Kong — and Hong Kong people building their future in Shandong — to each take one less detour.”

contact.p: You don't need to know exactly what to ask. Say it the way you normally would — we'll take it one step at a time.
